pokedexEntries.bk: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

pokedexEntries.wh: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
